title: MooseBlocks x Fabulous Fences (Deprecated)
description: A pack that adds compatibility between the MooseBlocks resource pack and Sage Axolotl's Fabulous Fences resource pack. (Now Deprecated)
body:
# This pack is now deprecated
Due to some bugs with the addon pack that I was unable to isolate, I have gone ahead and created my own custom fence models and textures from scratch and incorporated them into the main MooseBlocks pack.

If you like the fancy fences but don't want to use MooseBlocks, please please go check out Fabulous Fences from Sage Axolotl, it is an absolutely fantastic pack!

~~Blocks made by a Moose and fences made by an Axolotl~~
~~This pack adds compatibility with my resource pack MooseBlocks and Sage Axolotl's pack Fabulous Fences. This is the intended experience for Mooseblocks as a whole but I didn't want to take away from Sage Axolotl's fantastic work. You must have Fabulous fences installed. If you enjoy my packs please join the discord server and give me feedback so I can continue to improve them! Installation~~
~~Your load order for resource packs should have Mooseblocks at the bottom, then Fabulous Fences, then this pack.~~
